summary: Construct per-level lists of FieldLine from contour segments

identity.direction: Declared inputs to Per-level lists of target line objects
identity.definition: Construct per-level lists of FieldLine from contour segments
identity.model: Source collection mapping; no extra field reconstruction
identity.geometry: One-dimensional or planar sampled geometry as explicitly stated
identity.boundary: Constructed line inherits corrected open ordering, bounded crossing and null-field rejection from its explicit dependency.
assumptions: Finite contour vertices sufficient for SciPy splprep
Corrected d_ds requires N>=3 and distinct adjacent vertices
Curvature requires finite nonzero tangent-aligned B at line points
Grid interpolation queries lie inside finite input support

inputs.name: contourset
inputs.units: levels in caller flux-label units; vertices length
inputs.constraints: Each allsegs entry contains finite planar segments

outputs.name: collection
outputs.description: Per-level lists of target line objects

preconditions: Finite contour vertices sufficient for SciPy splprep
Corrected d_ds requires N>=3 and distinct adjacent vertices
Curvature requires finite nonzero tangent-aligned B at line points
Grid interpolation queries lie inside finite input support
supported: Named analytic, manufactured, invariant or reference fixtures in the direct tests
excluded: Intersection is bounded to fitted parameter intervals and rejects no-crossing/multiple-root cases; tangency/completeness remains unqualified
Arbitrary contour topology, magnetic-axis limit and physical stability are unqualified
get_kappa_n_2 requires uniform xy grid and nonzero flux gradient

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Unsupported source input shape/domain may raise array, assertion, linear-algebra or SciPy errors; no missing-value or knot repair is inferred.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Underlying numerical or interpolation exceptions propagate.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Collection construction is direct; later crossing calls inherit the bounded numerical search and explicit failure of the line dependency.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No guarantee of valid partially out-of-support results; class constructor exceptions do not return an object.

example.description: Bounded executable example for Contour field-line collection FieldLineSet
example.code:
import numpy as np
from types import SimpleNamespace
from scirel.geometry.fieldline import FieldLineSet
c=SimpleNamespace(levels=[.2],allsegs=[[np.array([[.2,0.],[.6,0.],[1.,0.]])]])
r=FieldLineSet(c)
assert len(r.flset[.2])==1
